title: cyananthus flavus subsp. montanus
intro: Cyananthus flavus subsp. montanus, commonly known as the Mountain Toadshade, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, supporting cardiovascular health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which may help to modulate the nervous system and provide analgesic and sedative effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the properties and benefits of this plant, and it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
